notes: 'Woe is me' is read with the copula on לְ as the prepositional predicate under rule 49, the preposition having no English word of its own; the note on that unit names the rule 40 alternative.
The italic 'my' before 'grief' is added — חֳלִי carries no suffix — while the 'my' of 'my hurt' and 'my wound' each answer to a written suffix.
